text: When I was young I mended printing presses, and nothing ever stayed mended. These days I break things in my own house, on purpose, and I keep careful notes about exactly how.

barnaby.instruct: A cheerful English man of about seventy with a warm, dry, amused voice and a light English accent, medium pitch, clear and easy to understand, unhurried, like a retired mechanic telling a good story in a quiet room.
